text:
Alex: Heads-up — we're enforcing SSE-KMS for object uploads and DB backup artifacts starting Friday. Need RBAC updates, audit schema changes, perf validation, and vuln triage signoff.
Mira: Is the change global or opt-in per-tenant?
Alex: Global default; support can request temporary exceptions for legacy tenants. Goal: zero unencrypted-at-rest backups.
Jordan: Major risk: KMS GenerateDataKey QPS. Re-encrypting millions of small objects could throttle KMS. We need a throughput plan, quota requests, and retry/backoff patterns.
Lee: Found an issue in backup-agent v2.1.2 where chunking writes plaintext temp files to /var/tmp on staging. Flagging for vuln triage.
Mira: Confirmed. Fix in PR #478 replaces direct writes with mktemp + secure remove (shred -u). Recommend blocking < v2.1.3 from uploading to prod.
Mira: fix snippet:
```bash
TMP=$(mktemp --tmpdir backup-XXXXXX)
# write to $TMP then shred -u $TMP
```
Jordan: RBAC needs a narrowly scoped role for the agent: s3:PutObject + kms:GenerateDataKey* on backup-specific resources. Example IAM fragment:
```json
{"Action": ["s3:PutObject","kms:GenerateDataKey*"], "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-backups/*","arn:aws:kms:...:key/EXAMPLE"]}
```
Lee: Audit log fields to add: encryption_scheme (sse-kms|sse-s3|cse), cmk_alias, cmk_keyid, uploader_principal, source_ip, bucket, object_size_bytes, reencrypt_performed (bool), and agent_version. Ship to auditbeat -> ES with 30d retention.
Alex: Also propose an async re-encryptor job to pick unencrypted objects during a maintenance window. Start with a canary subset and monitor error rate.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled Fri 02:00 UTC to prod-ops.
Mira: Perf note — SSE-KMS adds ~25-40ms for GenerateDataKey. For many small PUTs consider session envelope-key caching to reduce calls.
Jordan: For hot paths, ephemeral grants or caching are options. I'll run a load test: 2k concurrent multipart uploads with realistic sizes to surface KMS throttling.
Lee: For vuln triage: when we block old agents, ensure restore paths still work for customers stuck on older clients. Need a migration plan and support docs.
Samir: Question — will DB backups share CMKs with S3 backups? Mixed keys complicate restore grants.
Alex: Plan: tenant-specific CMKs for DBs when available; otherwise fallback to a global backups CMK. Backup metadata must include key id and alias for deterministic restores.
Mira: I'll merge the temp-file fix, create the upload block policy for < v2.1.3, and open the audit schema PR.
Jordan: I'll post load test results and KMS metric histograms after Thu 18:00 UTC run.
Lee: I'll update the audit mapping, add an alert if re-encryptor error rate >1%, and add a dashboard for key usage.
Alex: Summary of actions: (1) Security: patch/block legacy agents; (2) Infra: KMS quota request + retry guidance; (3) Ops: implement canary re-encryptor + sampling; (4) Support: opt-out ticket flow and restore migration docs. I'll file JIRA and link it here.
Mira: ACK — will follow up with PR #478 and JIRA BACKUP-1123.
Jordan: ACK — will share test artifacts and KMS error traces.
Lee: ACK — will include audit mapping in the schema PR.
Samir: Tagging compliance for retention approval on the expanded audit fields.
ops-bot: incident-bot: reminder: maintenance window Fri 02:00-04:00 UTC for canary.
